svg.title: Platform reviews everyone's code and is rarely reviewed back
svg.desc: Chord diagram of code reviews exchanged between five engineering teams during one sprint. Each team owns an arc sized by its total review activity; each ribbon links two teams with a width proportional to the pull requests they reviewed for each other. The Platform team's inbound reviews dwarf its outbound ones: it reviews nearly everyone's code but few teams review Platform's.
svg.text: Platform reviews everyone's code and is rarely reviewed back
Cross-team pull-request reviews over one sprint (illustrative data)
